Is the structure at the centre of the images a cross-section of a blood vessel or a pulmonary nodule? Answer with one word, Vessel or Nodule, then one short sentence of reasoning, then the estimated diameter in mm.

content.text:
I don't see any images attached to your message — only the text description came through. I can't responsibly classify the structure without viewing the slices.

If you re-upload the images, here's what I'll assess:
- **Vessel**: elongates or shifts position across consecutive slices, tubular/branching shape, connects to other vascular structures.
- **Nodule**: remains round and roughly centred across slices, appears and disappears over a short craniocaudal span consistent with a sphere, no branching continuity.

Please attach the 9 slices and I'll give you the one-word answer, reasoning, and diameter estimate.
